fields.value: UM XAI Explainable - GRS Impact of scenario complexity

dsDescriptionValue.value: In this project, we perform a user study to evaluate the effectiveness of Social Choice-Based Explanations for Group Recommender Systems in different complex scenarios, whose complexity is determined by the number of group members, the number of possible items, and the diversity between group members' preferences. The collected answer, properly anonymized, are collected in this dataset. Information on the experiment are available in the preregistration document, which can be accessed, together with the R script for reproducing the performed statistical analyses, at the link: https://osf.io/3dcht/

publicationCitation.value: Barile, F., Draws, T., Inel, O. et al. Evaluating explainable social choice-based aggregation strategies for group recommendation. User Model User-Adap Inter 34, 1–58 (2024).

files.description:
evaluations.csv: contains the evaluations provided by the participants for each scenario. More specifically, each participant evaluated four group configurations in a specific combination of the control conditions (aggregation strategy and explanation). \n

The columns are:
- Id: automatic generated identifier;
- Age: age group of the participant (1: "8-25", 2: "26-35", 3: "36-45", 4: "46-55", 5: ">55", 6: "prefer not to say");
- Gender: self-identified gender of the participant (1: "male", 2: "female", 3: "other", 4: "prefer not to say");
- Agg: control condition specifying the considered aggregation strategy (APP: "Approval Voting", MAJ: "Majority", ADD: "Additive", LMS: "Least Misery", MPL: Most Pleasure", or FAI: "Fairness"); for more information please refer to the pre-registration document available at: https://osf.io/3dcht/.
- Expl: control condition specifying if the participant was provided with an explanation of the recommendation (0: "No Explanation", 1: "Basic Explanation"); for more information please refer to the pre-registration document available at: https://osf.io/3dcht/.
- Group_conf: specific group configuration evaluated ("uniform", "divergent", "coalitional", and "minority"); for more information please refer to the pre-registration document available at: https://osf.io/3dcht/.
- Fairness: Evaluation of the perceived fairness of the recommendation, on a 7-point Likert scale (from -3 to 3); for more information please refer to the pre-registration document available at: https://osf.io/3dcht/.
- Consensus: Evaluation of the perceived consensus of the recommendation, on a 7-point Likert scale (from -3 to 3); for more information please refer to the pre-registration document available at: https://osf.io/3dcht/.
- Satisfaction: Evaluation of the satisfactions of the recommendation, on a 7-point Likert scale (from -3 to 3); for more information please refer to the pre-registration document available at: https://osf.io/3dcht/.
- Attention: answer to  the specific attention check. The correct answer depends on the value in Group_conf ("uniform": 3; "divergent": 6; "minority": 4; "coalitional": 1)
- Feedback: general feedback provided for the specific group configuration
files.label: evaluations.csv
